description:
Screen five chemicals using CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) to determine if they are EPCRA Section 302 Extremely Hazardous Substances (EHS). 

Chemicals to screen:
1. Phosgene (CAS 75-44-5)
2. Chlorine (CAS 7782-50-5)
3. Sulfuric Acid (CAS 7664-93-9)
4. Toluene (CAS 108-88-3)
5. Acetone (CAS 67-64-1)

For each chemical, navigate to the 'Regulatory Information' section. If it is an EHS, record the 'EPCRA 302 EHS TPQ' value. If it is not listed as an EHS, mark it as NO.

Create a CSV file named 'epcra_screening_report.csv' on the Desktop (/home/ga/Desktop/epcra_screening_report.csv) with the following exact headers and format:

Chemical Name,EHS Status,TPQ (lbs)
Phosgene,YES,10
...

Use 'YES' or 'NO' for EHS Status. If 'NO', set TPQ to 'N/A'.
